neighbours.label: the token ' imagine' after a negated can't / couldn't ('I can't imagine ...')
fire: Honestly, I can't imagine moving to a city without a decent bakery.
My grandmother couldn't imagine a Sunday without the whole family at her table.
Most teachers can't imagine grading forty essays in a single weekend anymore.
After the storm, residents couldn't imagine how the bridge had survived.
He said he can't imagine retiring before his youngest finishes college.
We couldn't imagine a better venue for the reunion than that old barn.
As a nurse, she can't imagine working a night shift without strong coffee.
The fans couldn't imagine the team losing at home to such a weak side.
quiet: Honestly, I can't afford moving to a city without a decent bakery.
My grandmother couldn't stand a Sunday without the whole family at her table.
Most teachers can't manage grading forty essays in a single weekend anymore.
After the storm, residents couldn't explain how the bridge had survived.
He said he won't consider retiring before his youngest finishes college.
We couldn't find a better venue for the reunion than that old barn.
As a nurse, she can't handle working a night shift without strong coffee.
The fans couldn't believe the team lost at home to such a weak side.

notes: card: ' imagine' is 19 of the top 32, nearly always after can't/couldn't. Near misses keep the negation and swap the verb.
